Landing.winBody: Beyond Money took first place. Thank you <bernhackt>BärnHäckt</bernhackt> for the weekend, and <postfinance>PostFinance</postfinance> for the challenge.
Landing.winPhotoAlt: The Beyond Money team with the first-place cheque at BärnHäckt 2026
Landing.heroSubtitle: Beyond Money reads your Swiss bank statements, sorts every line, watches for the unusual — and answers when you ask. The charts are there too, once there is something of yours to draw.
Landing.trust2: An assistant that answers from your figures
Landing.trust3: Push notifications keep you in the loop
Landing.askIntro: Hi. I read your bank statements so you don't have to. Ask me something.
Landing.ask1Answer: Rent, groceries, and one surprisingly expensive Tuesday. Every line lands in a category, and I show you the ones that actually moved this month.
Landing.ask2Answer: My favourite question. I check twenty-six patterns across your year — a charge that repeated, a recipient you have never paid before, a salary that never arrived.
Landing.ask3Answer: When a month closes I add up what was left over and offer to put it in a pot. Nothing gets moved without you — but there is usually more there than people expect.
Landing.ctaTitle: Ready to take control of your financial story?
Landing.ctaBody: Sign up, load the demo statements, and have four charts of your own within a minute. No bank credentials, no third-party trackers, and an account you can delete outright whenever you like.
Landing.ctaCheck1: Free, with no plan to pick
Landing.ctaCheck2: No tracking, no ads, no third parties
Landing.ctaNote: Takes less than 30 seconds to begin.
Landing.faqAnomalyQuestion: How does your anomaly detection work?
Landing.faqAnomalyAnswer: Twenty-six patterns, checked over your whole history when you press the button — a charge that repeated, a recipient you have never paid before, a subscription that quietly went up, a salary that never landed. It is arithmetic on your own figures, not a guess about you. Most of what I flag turns out to be your own perfectly good spending, so I say what I noticed and let you tick it off.
Landing.faqBankQuestion: Do I have to hand over my e-banking login?
Landing.faqBankAnswer: Never — there is nowhere to type one. Beyond Money connects to no bank at all. It reads statement files you already have, so there are no credentials to store and nothing here worth stealing.
Landing.faqDataQuestion: Where do the numbers come from?
Landing.faqDataAnswer: A CSV export from your bank, imported under Account → Data. Your browser reads the file first and shows you what it found, so nothing leaves the device until you press import. There is also a year of synthetic statements to look around with, if you would rather not start with your own.
Landing.faqBatziAnswer: Your rows and no one else's. I query a throwaway in-memory copy of your own transactions — no other accounts, no users, no sessions, no file on disk. Being straight with you: the figures I need for an answer do go to Google's Gemini API, because that is the model doing the writing.
Landing.faqDeleteQuestion: Can I delete all of it?
Landing.faqDeleteAnswer: Yes, in one press. Account settings has a delete button that takes the account with every transaction, budget, savings pot and finding attached to it. No export to wait for, no retention period, no email asking you to reconsider.

AnomalyRules.AMOUNT_SPIKE: Much larger than what this merchant usually charges you. Sometimes a bulk purchase, sometimes a mistyped amount.

AnomalyRules.INCOME_DEVIATION: Regular income arrived, but for a noticeably different amount than usual. Check the payslip or invoice behind it.
AnomalyRules.LARGE_TRANSFER: A transfer between your own accounts that is much larger than your usual one.
AnomalyRules.MERCHANT_CONCENTRATION: One merchant accounted for an unusually large share of the month's spending.
AnomalyRules.MISSING_EXPECTED_INCOME: A payment that normally arrives on a regular rhythm is overdue. If it is your salary, it is worth chasing.
AnomalyRules.NEW_CATEGORY: The first spending you have recorded in this category.
AnomalyRules.NEW_COUNTERPARTY: Money moved to a recipient that has not appeared in your transfers before.
AnomalyRules.NEW_MERCHANT: The first time this merchant has appeared in your statements.
AnomalyRules.NEW_RECURRING_PAYMENT: A payment has started repeating on a schedule that was not there before — often a free trial that has begun charging.
AnomalyRules.PAYMENT_METHOD_SHIFT: Your spending moved between accounts or cards compared with previous months.
AnomalyRules.RECURRING_PAYMENT_CHANGE: A subscription or standing payment changed price. Decide whether it is still worth what it now costs.
AnomalyRules.RECURRING_PAYMENT_DISAPPEARANCE: A regular payment has stopped arriving. That can mean a cancelled service, or a card that expired and a payment that silently failed.
AnomalyRules.REFUND_ANOMALY: A refund noticeably larger than the ones you usually receive.
AnomalyRules.REPEAT_CHARGE: The same merchant billed an identical amount more than once on one day. Often a genuine double charge — worth comparing against your receipt and asking for a refund.
AnomalyRules.ROUND_NUMBER_TRANSACTION: A large, exactly round amount — more typical of a transfer or a manual payment than a purchase.
AnomalyRules.SAVINGS_RATE_CHANGE: The share of income you kept this month moved sharply against recent months.
AnomalyRules.SUBSCRIPTION_ACCUMULATION: Several new recurring payments have appeared over a short period. Together they add up to more than any one of them looks.
AnomalyRules.UNUSUALLY_LARGE_TRANSACTION: One of the largest outflows in your whole history. Worth a glance simply to confirm you made it.
AnomalyRules.UNUSUAL_DAY: This merchant is normally used on other days of the week.
AnomalyRules.UNUSUAL_FINANCIAL_IMPACT: A single payment large enough to matter against a month's income, not just against your usual spending.

DangerZone.clearBodyAll: {count, plural, one {# transaction, and every finding about it, is removed from this account.} other {# transactions, and every finding about them, are removed from this account.}} Your budgets, savings goals and merchant rules stay. It cannot be undone.
DangerZone.clearBodyOne: {count, plural, one {# transaction booked to {account}, and every finding about it, is removed.} other {# transactions booked to {account}, and every finding about them, are removed.}} Everything on your other accounts stays, along with your budgets, savings goals and merchant rules. It cannot be undone.
DangerZone.cleared: {count, plural, one {# transaction cleared} other {# transactions cleared}}

DangerZoneErrors.unknownAccount: There is nothing on that account any more.
DangerZoneErrors.clearFailed: Could not clear those transactions. Try again.

Chat.title: Ask Batzi
Chat.subtitle: Ask anything about your year
Chat.intro: I can show you where you could save, check for anything shady, list your subscriptions and help split a month's surplus across your saving goals. Ask away.
Chat.suggestion2: Is something shady going on in my account?
Chat.suggestion3: What subscriptions am I paying for?
Chat.suggestion4: How should I split last month's surplus across my saving goals?
Chat.disclaimer: Answers come from a model reading your own figures. Check anything that matters.
Chat.failed: Something went wrong — try asking again.
Chat.partialReply: The connection hiccuped before the answer arrived — here is what I found.
Chat.chartFailed: The assistant sent a chart this browser could not draw.
Chat.pieChartLabel: Pie chart: {title}. The figures are listed in the table after the chart.

happy.recentEmpty: There is no spending in your statements yet.
happy.recentHeadline: Your last {count} payments, from {from} to {to}, {total} in total.
happy.anomaliesRunning: A check of your transactions is running right now — the findings will be ready in a moment.
happy.anomaliesNever: Your transactions have never been checked. You can start the check on the Account page.
happy.anomaliesOutdated: New transactions have arrived since the last check, so its findings are out of date. You can start a fresh check on the Account page.
happy.anomaliesClean: The last check found nothing unusual.
happy.anomaliesHeadline: The last check reports {groups} kinds of finding across {count} transactions, {action} of them worth a look.
happy.anomaliesNote: Most of this is your own perfectly ordinary spending. The details are on the Anomalies page.
happy.subsEmpty: I cannot find any recurring charges — no merchant bills you a steady amount on a steady rhythm.
happy.subsHeadline: You pay for {count} recurring subscriptions, {yearly} a year in total.
happy.subsNote: Contractual fixed costs like rent, insurance and taxes are not counted here.
happy.potentialFree: In {month} you had {amount} left over that is not in a saving goal yet.
happy.potentialOverspent: In {month} you spent {amount} more than you earned.
happy.potentialNoMonth: There are no figures for a completed month yet.
happy.potentialSplit: Of your {year} spending, {fixed} is fixed costs and {flexible} is flexible.
happy.potentialNote: Rent, insurance and taxes can hardly be cut; the categories above can.
happy.categoriesEmpty: Nothing has been spent in {year} yet.
happy.categoriesHeadline: In {year} you spent {total}, across {payments} payments in {count} categories.

ChatDebug.intro: Requests to the model endpoint, newest first.
ChatDebug.noFallback: nothing — this is the only model
ChatDebug.empty: No requests logged yet. Ask the assistant something.

Errors.title: Something went wrong
Errors.body: The page hit an error it could not recover from. Trying again usually works.
Errors.globalBody: Something broke before the page could render. Reloading usually fixes it.
Errors.notFoundBody: That address does not exist — or it moved. Your dashboard is still where you left it.
Errors.offlineBody: Your transactions live on the server, so this page needs a connection. It will work again as soon as you have one.
